{{DISPLAYTITLE:Cheats in ''Grand Theft Auto VI''}}{{cheats}}
The following is a list of '''cheats''' in {{VI}}. Cheat codes can be activated after completing the main story, provided the player has also met the individual unlock requirements. Activating a cheat prevents the game from being saved.<ref name="GameSpotCheats">[https://www.gamespot.com/articles/all-gta-6-cheats-and-how-to-unlock-them/ All GTA 6 Cheats And How To Unlock Them] - GameSpot, November 18, 2026.</ref>

==Activating cheats==
After completing the main story and unlocking the relevant cheat, open the in-game phone, hold L1 + R1, and enter the directional inputs using the D-pad.
